district_prose.The Kita District: The Kita District Campaign Territory. Kita Ward (北区) Northern Tokyo, between Itabashi and Arakawa wards. Working-class residential, old commercial strips, the Kanda river running through it. Not on the tourist routes. Continuously inhabited since before the current infrastructure, which means the veil layer has depth... accumulated history, accumulated energy, accumulated everything. The thin spots in Kita are not thin because of 2011 alone. 2011 accelerated and deepened what was already there. The district was already interesting to practitioners.
